quarterly_data.quarter: Sandisk press release: Sandisk Details Growth Strategy and Long-Term Financial (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At its 2026 Investor Day Sandisk introduced a financial model for fiscal 2028 through fiscal 2030: revenue expected to grow mid-to-high teens, consistent with bit growth; non-GAAP gross margin sustained at approximately 80 percent; non-GAAP operating margin approximately 75 percent, assuming operating expenses around five percent of revenue; adjusted free cash flow margin approximately 50 percent after taxes, capital expenses and working capital. CFO Luis Visoso said confidence in the model comes from the multi-year NBMs; Sandisk expects to return 100 percent of excess cash to shareholders after investing in the business.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2028-FY2030: revenue mid-to-high teens growth; non-GAAP GM approximately 80 percent; operating margin approximately 75 percent; adjusted FCF margin approximately 50 percent

quarterly_data.quarter: Sandisk press release: Sandisk Details Growth Strategy and Long-Term Financial (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Investor Day technology and market outlook: Sandisk unveiled a two-dimensional scaling strategy on its CBA technology to produce custom derivatives capital-efficiently; the first example, BiCS9 QLC, combines a proven BiCS8 array with a BiCS10-based CMOS wafer for AI workloads. The new BiCS10 QLC node achieves a 60% increase in bit density compared to BiCS8 (Sandisk calls it the industry benchmark for bit density, performance and power efficiency). Sandisk expects the AI data center to become dramatically more storage intensive as KV cache reshapes the memory hierarchy, with the total available market for enterprise data center flash growing to 1.2 zettabytes by 2030, and says an industry ecosystem is forming to support HBF adoption.
quarterly_data.figure: BiCS10 QLC: 60% increase in bit density vs BiCS8; enterprise data center flash TAM 1.2 zettabytes by 2030
